title.narrative: Raiffeisen Leasing Kosovo Senior Loan - Climate

description.narrative:
Project Outcome: Stakeholder effects: Access to finance for climate projects and for W-MSMEs: Many cities in Kosovo suffer from poor air quality and a rapid replacement of the obsolete vehicle fleet is pressing not only from climate change but also public health perspective. MSMEs in Kosovo have been financially constrained, particularly following the pandemic and Russias invasion of Ukraine. W-MSMEs are scarce and even more constrained. IFC anticipates that the Project will help increase the access to much needed climate finance for MSMEs and individuals in Kosovo. The Project will also support RLKO in establishing a new business line specifically for business owned and/or led by women.
Market Creation: Competitiveness: The proposed investment is part of a programmatic approach in Kosovo that is intended to enhance the competitiveness of the MSME finance market through demonstration and replication channels. Under the program, IFC will provide financing to five financial institutions. The overall objective is to expand lending to underserved MSMEs, particularly those owned by women, and farmers, including support for their climate projects.

The proposed investment consists of senior loan of up to EUR5 million to Raiffeisen Leasing Kosovo (RLKO or the Company), the largest leasing company in Kosovo (the Project). The loan proceeds will focus on women-owned MSMEs and climate related projects by MSMEs and individuals in Kosovo. The Project presents an opportunity for an impactful engagement in Kosovo, an IDA and FCS country, with pressing needs in access to finance for MSMEs and green transition, exacerbated by the impacts of Covid-19 and Russias invasion of Ukraine. The Project is expected to be supported by the IDA20 Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA PSW BFF), the Women Entrepreneurship Finance Initiative (We-Fi) and the Women Entrepreneurs Opportunity Facility (WEOF)
